textRuns.value: To test a project: fill the YELLOW cells in templates\project_intake.xlsx (a worked example is beside them), then run  python src/ingest_project_intake.py  (validates and writes data/projects/, replacing by project_id), then  python src/build_project_appraisal.py  and Refresh here.
Projects are judged with the SAME per-scenario tax, WACC and hurdle as the company DCF — one world, one ruler. One-time setup: pip install openpyxl.
